scope.isolation_rule: Both equal-skill duelists possess the same available prototype Plays. Each ablation removes the same one Play from both duelists. Canonical mechanics remain null.

rules.fourth_play: record the attempted sequence and suppress the fourth Play

plays.trigger: Remedy against a center/high thrust before contact.
plays.resolution: Variant A: one Longsword roll combines defence and attack and spends the action. A successful blade-seeking result may be changed through before firm contact.

plays.trigger: Remedy against a committed high descending cut before contact.
plays.resolution: Roll the counter-cut first. Only if it succeeds, is not defeated by Durchwechseln, and produces a soft bind may the separate point continuation be rolled.

plays.trigger: Attacker continuation after a successful blade-seeking defence while contact remains none-before-firm-contact.
plays.resolution: A Longsword success changes below the defence and restores the initiating attack on the other line.
Spend the action and roll Longsword before the target's recovery activation.
Spend the action and roll Longsword. No Wrestling prerequisite is assumed.

plays.source: Pseudo-Peter von Danzig, Starhemberg Fechtbuch Cod.44.A.8, 1452, ff. 23v.1-23v.2; Hagedorn transcription, Chidester draft translation.
plays.trigger: Remedy against a high descending cut; its rejoinder is available only when that same opponent attempts Durchwechseln below this Schielhau before contact.
plays.resolution: Roll the Schielhau Remedy. If successful and answered by Durchwechseln, roll the historically specific long-point extension as an internal rejoinder; success defeats the change-through and deals baseline test damage. It is not a generic Counter-Feint.

simulation_model.scenario: Equal Skill 10, 8 HP duel; both fighters possess the same repertoire; Variant A; action preservation disabled.
simulation_model.ablations: Full repertoire plus seven cells removing exactly one Play from both fighters.

calibration_flags.policy: These are artificial exercise rates, held fixed across every ablation. Do not tune Zornhau-Ort or Pommel Strike to outcomes produced by them.
